info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Interactions-v5-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescriptions Interactions API provides users with the capability to retrieve detailed interactions between different pharmacy prescriptions. This API is essential for healthcare providers who need to ensure patient safety by understanding how medications may affect one another. Through this API, developers can access interaction data to assist in medication management, enabling better decision-making for prescription management systems. Typical consumers include pharmacists, healthcare applications, and clinical decision support tools seeking to enhance their prescription verification processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch a list of possible interactions related to the provided prescriptions. It helps ensure patient safety by alerting healthcare providers to potential drug interactions.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving interactions related to prescriptions. This body must conform to the specified schema. Please ensure that all necessary fields are included to receive accurate information about prescription interactions.
